# 1 Enoch Chapter 76 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 1 Enoch Chapter 76 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 76:1 — 'mist of heaven' vs. 'clouds of heaven'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "mist of-the-heaven" | Literal Ge'ez; the winds disperse atmospheric moisture |
| LOGOS | "mist of heaven" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "clouds of heaven" | More vivid and natural in English |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted 'mist of heaven' (EMET/LOGOS). The Ge'ez term refers specifically to the low-hanging atmospheric moisture that the winds disperse, distinct from 'clouds' proper. 'Mist' preserves this nuance.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 76:4 — 'portal of fire' in the south wind

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "portal of-the-fire" | Literal; south wind portal brings scorching heat |
| LOGOS | "portal of fire" | Same |
| PNEUMA | (included but not separately labeled) | The 'fire' portal brings the scorching sirocco |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three converge on 'portal of fire.' This refers to the hot, dry wind from the south — the sirocco — which the text characterizes as 'fire.' No dispute.

**Status:** Converged.

---

## 76:10 — 'beneficial' vs. 'agreeable' vs. 'good'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "beneficial" | The east/north winds are productive and healthy |
| LOGOS | "beneficial" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "beneficial" | All three agree |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three converge on 'beneficial.' No dispute.

**Status:** Converged.

---

## 76:14 — 'winds of blessing' vs. 'prosperous winds'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "winds-of-blessing and-prosperity" | Literal construct |
| LOGOS | "winds of blessing and prosperity" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "winds of blessing and prosperity" | All agree |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Converged. No dispute.

**Status:** Converged.

---
